name: Multi-Agent LLM Router
description: Webhook routes tasks to Groq (fast), OpenAI (quality), or Ollama (local) based on the priority field, then returns the LLM response.

nodes.name: Extract Response
nodes.logic: extract choices[0].message.content or message.content or response

flow: Webhook → Extract Route → Route Switch → [Groq|OpenAI|Ollama] → Merge → Extract Response → Respond
